image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from the front. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, horizontal space bar at the bottom center of the key layout. The keys are round with metallic stems, typical of older mechanical typewriters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is elongated, but it does not span the 'full width' of the typewriter body or even the full width of the key block; it is centered between side margins/frames.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is significantly longer than the circular typebars/keys above it, satisfying the relative proportion requirement.

The complex mechanical linkages behind the keys appear somewhat fused and lack distinct geometric separation, which could be due to low resolution or AI generation struggling with fine mechanical details.
